name: The Vorleif
storyline: Long ago, a great civilization ruled these lands — until the Devourer came. It consumed the world piece by piece, leaving behind only ruins, ash and broken fragments of reality adrift in the void. Of all who once lived here, only two schools of elves endured: the light and the dark. Bound by old rivalry yet driven by the same need, their scholars, hunters and warriors now walk among the remains of the fallen, gathering relics, forgotten knowledge and the last sparks of a vanished age — while somewhere beyond the edge of the world, the hunger still waits.
summary: Vorleif is a dark gothic fantasy MMORPG for PC and Android. An ancient hunger devoured a whole civilization and left only shards of worlds drifting in the void. On the last continent, two schools of elves — light and dark — venture into the ruins to scavenge what remains. Explore a wild land of swamps, mines and burnt forests, enter instanced mini-worlds alone or with a party of up to five, and master blade, bow and staff.
